hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF source and the exact Rust test from its attribute through the final LF.

selectors.protects: JSON and SSE report a heuristic response produced after model failure. Health counts those requests once.
selectors.detects: An HTTP 200 hiding a model failure, an SSE-specific missing header, or a miscount.
selectors.needs: An empty local model directory and an ephemeral loopback socket. No weights, internet, or GPU.
selectors.reviewScope: An empty model directory causes each request to use the heuristic, so clients can read the reason without relying on response-text or private log strings.
